items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: So he asked me if I wanted a job, and I said, "Sure." So I worked at the Savoy on numerous occasions.

ctx.x: Teddy Hill was forming a band, or he had a band in the Savoy Ballroom... No, he was getting ready to go in the Savoy Ballroom. And he heard I had come' out of the Blue Rhythm Band. So he asked me if I wanted a job, and I said, "Sure." So I worked at the Savoy on numerous occasions.
And of course, you knew Teddy Hill from earlier work
